atomic_fields.name: decodable
atomic_fields.instruction: Score 1 only when exactly 49 sequential frames decode and every frame can be inspected; otherwise score 0.

atomic_fields.name: clean_prefix
atomic_fields.instruction: Across every frame 0-15, the source and causal footprint are absent and the receiver is in its specified clean state.

atomic_fields.name: source_after16

allowed_values.1: source partial or ambiguous after frame 15

atomic_fields.instruction: Judge source visibility across all frames 16-48.

atomic_fields.name: trigger_visible

allowed_values.1: trigger partial, occluded, or temporally ambiguous

atomic_fields.instruction: Use the frozen mechanism-specific trigger definition.

atomic_fields.name: footprint_after_trigger

allowed_values.0: footprint absent or present before the trigger
allowed_values.1: footprint weak, partial, or onset order ambiguous
allowed_values.2: expected footprint clear and first visible only after the trigger

atomic_fields.instruction: Inspect all 49 frames and use the frozen expected footprint.

atomic_fields.name: receiver_recognizable
atomic_fields.instruction: The intended receiver must remain identifiable throughout the event.

atomic_fields.name: fixed_camera
atomic_fields.instruction: Inspect all frames for cuts, reframing, pan, tilt, zoom, or drift.

atomic_fields.name: quality

allowed_values.1: judgeable with material artifacts or temporal incoherence

atomic_fields.instruction: Judge visual and temporal integrity across the complete video.

water_impact.trigger_definition: visible entry of the source through the water surface
water_impact.expected_footprint: a brief splash and expanding circular ripples

rigid_collision.trigger_definition: visible physical contact between source and receiver
rigid_collision.expected_footprint: a tipped contacted object and visible displacement of nearby objects

brittle_fracture.trigger_definition: visible strike of the intact brittle receiver by the source
brittle_fracture.expected_footprint: spreading visible cracks and several separated glass fragments

powder_impact.trigger_definition: visible source contact with the initially undisturbed powder bed
powder_impact.expected_footprint: a short powder plume and a visible impact crater

elastic_deformation.trigger_definition: visible source contact initiating receiver deformation
elastic_deformation.expected_footprint: a clearly visible temporary indentation or stretching of the receiver followed by elastic rebound

field_mediated_response.trigger_definition: visible closest approach followed by receiver motion while a gap remains; direct contact is a trigger failure
field_mediated_response.expected_footprint: clear receiver motion toward or away from the source while a visible gap remains between them

material_release.trigger_definition: visible impact or puncture that opens the intact receiver
material_release.expected_footprint: opening of the receiver followed by a visible outward pour or scatter of its contained particles

surface_trace.trigger_definition: visible source contact and motion along the initially unmarked surface
surface_trace.expected_footprint: a new localized imprint or groove confined to the source contact path
